name: American Burnweed
desc: American Burnweed (Erechtites hieraciifolius): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Erechtites hieraciifolius is a plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae. It is native to the Americas, but is found many places around the world having been introduced by human activity.
